pick.name: Tally
pick.why: Unlimited forms and responses free, webhooks/integrations, fastest to build.
pick.free_limits: Free: unlimited forms and submissions (fair use). Pro $24/mo

best_free.name: Formbricks (self-host)
best_free.why: Pick when data must stay on your infra (healthcare) or for in-product surveys.
best_free.free_limits: Community Edition self-host free; hosted cloud shown as 'coming soon'

alts.name: Fillout
alts.what: Form builder with logic and DB integrations
alts.why: Better for complex logic / writing to Airtable/Notion/Supabase; 1,000 responses/mo free.
alts.free_limits: Free: 1,000 responses/mo, unlimited forms, badge. Starter $15/mo

alts.name: Google Forms
alts.why: Free and familiar; limited logic and branding control.

decision: Tally is the most generous hosted form tool and doubles as waitlist capture. Self-host Formbricks (AGPL) when survey data must stay on your infrastructure; mind AGPL if you modify and distribute it.

verify.note: Shallow check only: free/commercial terms are consistent with the cited licence; not re-opened in this pass.
